# NGSS Life Science

> > Free NGSS-aligned lesson plans, worksheets, and labs for teaching life science standards from middle school through high school biology.

NGSS Life Science provides comprehensive, standards-aligned curriculum resources for educators teaching biology and life science. The site features free downloadable worksheets, interactive labs, and lesson plans covering core topics like genetics, evolution, cellular biology, and ecology, with many resources created by experienced educators like Shannan Muskopf.

## Key Topics

- NGSS Standards
- High School Biology
- Middle School Science
- DNA & Genetics
- Evolution & Natural Selection
- Cell Biology
- Photosynthesis & Cellular Respiration
- Ecology & Ecosystems
- Lesson Plans
- Free Worksheets
- Editable Resources
- Biology Labs
- Protein Synthesis
- Population Ecology
- Evidence of Evolution

## Core Resources & Home

- [Science and Engineering Practices & NGSS Curriculum](https://www.ngsslifescience.com): Homepage for NGSS Life Science curriculum with free lesson plans and teaching resources
- [Biology Lesson Plans: Free Worksheets, Projects & Labs](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/biology-lesson-plans): Main biology lesson plans hub covering DNA, genetics, photosynthesis for high/middle school

## Cellular Biology & Molecular Genetics

- [DNA Worksheets: Free DNA Replication & RNA Lesson Plans](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/dna-replication-worksheets): DNA structure and replication worksheets (HS-LS1-1,2,4, LS3-1) NGSS aligned
- [Protein Synthesis Worksheets: Transcription & Translation](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/protein-synthesis-worksheets): Transcription and translation worksheets (HS-LS1-1,4, LS3-1,2) NGSS aligned
- [Photosynthesis Worksheets: Middle & High School Lessons](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/photosynthesis-worksheets): Photosynthesis worksheets and labs aligned with NGSS HS-LS1-4,5 standards
- [Photosynthesis & Cellular Respiration Worksheets: NGSS](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/cellular-respiration-worksheets): Worksheets and lesson plans for photosynthesis and cellular respiration (HS-LS1-5,7, LS2-3)
- [Yeast Fermentation Labs: Anaerobic Respiration Lessons](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/fermentation-labs): Yeast fermentation labs for anaerobic respiration (HS-LS1-7, LS2-3) by Waldron & Doherty
- [Animal Cell Projects: Free Cell Organelles Lesson Plans](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/animal-cell-projects): Cell organelle projects and worksheets for middle school (MS-LS1-1,2) by Muskopf
- [Cell Membrane Worksheets, Free Cell Transport Lessons](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/cell-membrane-worksheets): Cell transport and osmosis/diffusion lessons (MS-LS1-2, HS-LS1-6) by Ludwig
- [Mitosis Worksheets, Free Cell Cycle Lesson Plans](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/mitosis-worksheets): Cell cycle and mitosis worksheets aligned with HS-LS1-4,5 NGSS standards

## Genetics & Heredity

- [Meiosis Worksheets: Free Genetic Variation Lesson Plans](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/meiosis-worksheets): Meiosis and genetic variation worksheets (HS-LS3-1,2, MS-LS3-2) NGSS aligned
- [Punnett Square Worksheets: Free Genetics Lesson Plans](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/punnett-square-worksheets): Punnett square and Mendelian genetics worksheets with Dragon Genetics simulation

## Evolution & Natural Selection

- [Evolution by Natural Selection Worksheets: Free Lessons](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/natural-selection-worksheets): Natural selection and adaptation worksheets (HS-LS4-2,3,4) with Concord Consortium
- [Evidence of Evolution Worksheets: Free Lesson Plans](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/evidence-of-evolution-worksheets): Evolution evidence including fossils and DNA comparison (HS-LS4-1, MS-LS4-2,3)
- [Speciation Worksheets: Free Evolutionary Lesson Plans](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/speciation-worksheets): Speciation and phylogenetic tree worksheets (HS-LS4-1,5, MS-LS4-1,2) NGSS aligned
- [Types of Evolution Worksheets: Free Evolution Lessons](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/evolution-types-worksheets): Artificial selection and genetic drift worksheets (HS-LS4-3, MS-LS4-5,6)

## Ecology & Ecosystems

- [Carbon Cycle Worksheets: Free Biogeochemical Cycle Lessons](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/carbon-cycle-worksheets): Carbon cycle and biogeochemical cycles labs (HS-LS2-4,5, MS-LS2-3) with modeling lab
- [Food Webs Worksheets: Energy Pyramid & Energy Flow](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/food-web-worksheets): Food web and energy pyramid worksheets (HS-LS2-4, MS-LS2-3) by Muskopf & Trimpe
- [Ecosystem Worksheets: Free Biome Ecology Lesson Plans](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/ecosystem-ecology-worksheets): Ecosystem and biome ecology worksheets (HS-LS2-2,6, MS-LS2-2,4) NGSS aligned
- [Population Growth Worksheets: Free Population Lessons](https://www.ngsslifescience.com/science/population-growth-worksheets): Population ecology and carrying capacity lessons (HS-LS2-1,2,7) with Concord Consortium
